lines.en: I manage to find Yumi standing on top of her favorite bridge (And also the only bridge I can think of off the top of my head.)
lines.zh: 我总算找到了 Yumi——她正站在她最爱的那座天桥上（也是我一时能想到的唯一一座天桥。）

lines.en: It's not really a safe place for a girl her age, or anyone for that matter, to be standing while it's snowing in the event of a tragic slip over the rails into traffic but-
lines.zh: 下着雪的时候，一个她这个年纪的女孩——或者说任何人——站在那儿都不太安全，万一不幸从栏杆上滑下去、掉进车流里——

lines.en: Well, there's not much traffic at all today. So that's good, at least.
lines.zh: 不过今天车流量小得可怜。所以至少这点还算不错。

lines.en: Things really seem to slow down in the winter.
lines.zh: 冬天一到，一切似乎都慢了下来。

lines.en: Yumi and I go back and forth atop the snowy overpass until my hands turn red and swell up from the cold.
lines.zh: Yumi 和我在这座积雪的天桥上来回走着，直到我的双手被冻得红肿发胀。

lines.en: Of course, she does not offer to hold them and warm them up.
lines.zh: 当然，她没有提出要帮我握着手暖一暖。

lines.en: But I do feel my heart begin to thaw out when she offers to chop my arms off and shove them down my throat.
lines.zh: 但当她提出要把我的胳膊砍下来、塞进我的喉咙里时，我确实感觉到自己的心开始融化了。

lines.en: What a lovely girl she is.
Yumi gets fed up when I allow her insults to bounce off of me and decides to head back to the dorm in a fit of protest.
lines.zh: Yumi 见我的辱骂全被弹开，受够了，一气之下决定回宿舍以示抗议。

lines.en: I note this down as a victory in my book because I inadvertently got her off of a dangerous overpass.
lines.zh: 我在心里把这记作一场胜利，因为我无意间让她离开了那座危险的天桥。

lines.en: But all I have to show for it is some frostbite and a flaccid penis.
lines.zh: 可我为此得到的全部回报，只有一点冻伤和一根软趴趴的阴茎。
